posts.title: Photos: City SC vs LAFC (11/23/26)
posts.description: St. Louis CITY SC defeated Los Angeles FC 3-2 on Monday, November 23, 2026, in Game 1 of their Western Conference Round One best-of-three series, earning the first playoff win in club history and taking a 1-0 series lead. Photos by Jerry McGrath.

posts.title: Photos: St. Louis Blues vs Edmonton Oilers (11/22/26)
posts.description: St. Louis Blues build some character... down 4-1 with 10 mins left in the third, they rally to take the game 5-4 in Shoot Outs (4 in a row)! Photos by Jerry McGrath

posts.title: Photos: St. Louis Blues vs New Jersey Devils (11/21/26)
posts.description: Blues win on a record setting night which saw 15 total goals scored in a 9-6 Blues victory, setting an Enterprise Center record. Neighbors ties a Blues record with 5 Assists as the Blues chase Connor Hellebuyck early in the first period. Photos by Jerry McGrath.
